title: Final velocity expression
description: Essential: Must give the correct expression for terminal velocity: v = mgr/(B²l).

title: Charge calculation
description: Essential: Must give the correct expression for total charge: q = Bl/r.

title: Heat generation expression
description: Essential: Must give the correct expression for heat: Q = mgl - m³g²r²/(2B⁴l²).

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Must apply Newton's first law to equate magnetic force with weight at terminal velocity.

title: Variable length recognition
description: Important: Must recognize that the effective conductor length below BD changes with height h.

title: External force function
description: Important: Must derive the correct linear function F = (2mg/l)h for part (3).

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Must apply energy conservation to relate mechanical energy loss to heat and kinetic energy.

title: Average velocity usage
description: Optional: May use average velocity to calculate charge via q = ΔΦ/R.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in force balance or wrong direction for magnetic force.

title: Length confusion
description: Pitfall: Using constant length l instead of variable length L = l - 2h below BD.
